$comment: Advisories the docs site cannot currently resolve by any dependency change. Each entry must state why no fix is reachable and expire, so it fails the build rather than quietly becoming permanent. Re-check upstream before extending an expiry.

allow.reason: Vulnerable range is <= 5.0.7, so every published version except 5.0.8 is flagged, and nothing in the tree depends on 5.0.8 yet. Reached only via @docusaurus/core -> serve-handler -> minimatch@3 -> brace-expansion@1.1.16. No fix is reachable: 1.x has no backport (tops out at 1.1.16), `npm audit fix --force` churns 357 packages and leaves the same 22 findings, and an override to ^5.0.8 breaks minimatch@3 at runtime because 5.x exports a named `expand` instead of a callable default. serve-handler backs `docusaurus serve` (local preview); the deployed artifact is a static site that never runs it.

Infinite loop in the ICNS parser. The vulnerable range is <= 2.0.2, which is every published version, so no dependency change reaches a fix and npm reports fixAvailable: false for @docusaurus/core itself. Reached only via @docusaurus/mdx-loader, which calls image-size at build time to read the dimensions of the manual's own committed images — the parser never sees third-party or user-supplied input, and the deployed artifact is a static site that does not run it. Drop this entry once image-size publishes a patched release and Docusaurus picks it up.

Infinite loops in the JXL and HEIF parsers, in the same image-size dependency and with the same <= 2.0.2 range as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr, so it is unfixable and unreachable for the same reasons: build-time only, over images committed to this repository, in a build that emits a static site. The manual ships no JXL or HEIF assets at all. Drop this entry with the other image-size entry once a patched release exists.
